articles.summary: DoorDash is withdrawing its support for H.R. 9720, while reaffirming its commitment to D.C. and offering partnership with the D.C. Council to repeal a new tax on SNAP deliveries and protect vulnerable communities.
articles.title: DoorDash Withdraws Support for H.R. 9720, Reaffirms Commitment to D.C., Offers Partnership with D.C. Council to Exempt SNAP Recipients from Delivery Tax
